articles.title: CVS Restores Weight-Loss Drug Coverage and Adds New Oral Options
articles.summary: CVS Caremark is adjusting its formulary strategy by restoring coverage for certain anti-obesity medications and incorporating new oral treatment options. This shift signals changing market dynamics in employer-sponsored obesity drug coverage as utilization management and new therapeutic classes evolve. Self-funded employers must evaluate how these formulary changes impact their plan design, employee benefit offerings, and overall specialty drug trend management.

articles.title: Novo Nordisk Lowers Cash Prices for Weight-Loss Medications
articles.summary: Novo Nordisk has announced cash price reductions for its popular weight-loss drugs. This shift in direct-to-consumer pricing dynamics could influence how self-funded employers evaluate their plan design options and utilization management strategies for high-cost GLP-1 therapies.
